code:
# Multi-node training must synchronize gradients across GPUs:
#
#   NVLink      -> fast GPU-to-GPU, WITHIN one VM/instance
#   InfiniBand  -> fast VM-to-VM networking   (Azure ND-series)
#   EFA         -> fast instance-to-instance  (AWS P4d/P4de, P5)
#
# NV-series and G-series are NOT built with this interconnect.
caption: The naming is a real signal, not marketing — pick the wrong family and multi-node training won't scale.

code:
# NOT: "does this VM have a GPU?"
#
# INSTEAD:
#   - does THIS GPU model have enough VRAM for the job's
#     working set (weights + gradients + optimizer state + activations)?
#   - does it have enough interconnect bandwidth to other GPUs,
#     if this is a multi-node job?
caption: An 80 GB A100 and a 16 GB T4 are both "a GPU" — they are not interchangeable.
